wiki.title: Bob Archuleta
wiki.extract: Bob Jerry Archuleta (born June 1, 1945) is an American politician serving in the California State Senate. He is a Democrat representing the 30th district, encompassing parts of southeastern Los Angeles County & Orange County. Prior to being elected to the state senate, he served on the Pico Rivera City Council.
